properties.table_content:
| Financial Segment / Need           | Value ($Billion) | Timeframe / Scope      | Details / Source                                     |
|------------------------------------|------------------|------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| Global Data Center Capex (Total)   | 2,900            | Through 2028           | For build and hardware costs                         |
| Hyperscaler Capex (Covered)        | 1,400            |                        | Funded by internal cash flows                        |
| Estimated Financing Gap            | 1,500            | Medium-term            | Needs external capital to fill                       |
| Private Credit Opportunity         | 800+             | Through 2028           | Led by Asset-Based Finance (ABF)                     |
| Incremental IG Tech Bond Supply    | 200              | Through 2028           | Expected corporate bond issuance                     |
| Data Center Securitized Credit     | 150              | Through 2028           | Projected ABS/CMBS issuance                          |
| US Securitized Issuance (Current)  | ~50              | To date                | Backed by ~10% of US data center capacity            |
| US Securitization Rate (Projected) | 25%              | By 2028                | Of new GWs in US securitized market                  |
properties.key_insight: Projected $2.9tr global data center capex through 2028 creates a $1.5tr financing gap to be filled by private credit, bonds, and securitization.
